title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Agent 365 agents as connected agents in declarative agents
summary: Hold: the installation path skips the consent window between permissions review and finishing deployment. The table also reports installation automation as undocumented, although Microsoft documents a package update API for deploying agents to users and groups. The rollout dates and administrator-controlled availability match Microsoft's notice.

claims.claim: Agent2Agent-enabled Microsoft Agent 365 agents can be connected agents in declarative agents built with Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit.
claims.quote: Microsoft is introducing support for Microsoft Agent 365 agents that implement the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol, allowing them to be used as connected agents in declarative agents built with Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; controls[0].note; Governance controls
claims.claim: Administrators install Agent2Agent-enabled Agent 365 agents from All agents in the Microsoft 365 admin center.
claims.quote: Administrators can install Microsoft Agent 365 agents that support the Agent2Agent protocol from the All agents page in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Governance controls
claims.claim: Users cannot install Agent2Agent-enabled Agent 365 agents themselves.
claims.quote: Users cannot install Agent2Agent-enabled Microsoft Agent 365 agents themselves.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Administrators can review Agent2Agent connections on a declarative agent's Connected agents tab before approving their use.
claims.quote: Administrators can review Agent2Agent-connected agents from the Connected agents tab in the declarative agent details page before approving their use.

claims.claim: Agent2Agent support joins existing OpenAPI and MCP server connections.
claims.quote: Agent2Agent support is added alongside existing support for OpenAPI and MCP server connections.

claims.claim: The roadmap names using Agent 365 agents within Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat and declarative agents.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Use Agent 365 agents within Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat and Declarative Agents

claims.claim: The roadmap description names Agent Builder and Copilot Studio as builders of agents that can use A2A connected agents.
claims.quote: If the agent implements the Agent2Agent protocol, it can be used as a connected agent for the agents that users build in Agent Builder or Copilot Studio.

claims.claim: The notice identifies agent administrators, developers using Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit and users assigned approved Agent 365 agents as affected groups.
claims.quote: Microsoft 365 administrators who manage agents in the Microsoft 365 admin center- Developers building declarative agents with Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit- Users who are assigned access to approved Microsoft Agent 365 agents

claims.claim: Microsoft recommends reviewing available agents, deciding which A2A agents to make available, reviewing connections and updating governance processes.
claims.quote: Review Microsoft Agent 365 agents available in the All agents page of the Microsoft 365 admin center.- Determine which Agent2Agent-enabled agents should be made available to users in your organization.

claims.claim: Microsoft suggests notifying administrators and developers about availability and the review and approval process.
claims.quote: Consider notifying administrators and developers in your organization about the availability of Agent2Agent-connected agents and the associated review and approval process.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: Developers declare connected agents by title ID in the manifest's worker_agents property.
claims.quote: You declare these connections in the agent manifest by listing agent title IDs in the worker_agents property.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: Copilot selects a connected agent using the task, name, description and example prompts without requiring the user to select it.
claims.quote: Microsoft 365 Copilot evaluates the connected agents declared in the manifest and selects one based on the current task and the connected agent's name, description, and example prompts.

claims.claim: Copilot sends the selected connected agent a text request.
claims.quote: Copilot sends a text request to the selected connected agent

claims.claim: Copilot incorporates the connected agent's text response into the declarative agent's ongoing conversation.
claims.quote: receives a text response, and incorporates that response into the declarative agent's ongoing interaction with the user.

claims.claim: Connected agents must be registered in the Microsoft Agent 365 agent registry.
claims.quote: You must register connected agents in the Microsoft Agent 365 agent registry.

claims.claim: An A2A connected agent requires a registered Agent2Agent agent card.
claims.quote: The other agent must be a declarative agent or have a registered Agent2Agent agent card.

claims.claim: The active agent sends text only to connected agents.
claims.quote: The active agent sends text only to a connected agent.

claims.claim: A2A agents can return text, Base64 image binaries and Base64 file binaries.
claims.quote: Agents with Agent2Agent agent cards return text, Base64 image binaries, and Base64 file binaries.

claims.claim: An external Agent 365 registration declares authentication through an authorization object referencing an existing authentication registration.
claims.quote: Instead of embedding authentication configuration directly in the agent registration, the registration references an existing authentication registration through the authorization object in the agentRegistration.

claims.claim: The primary agent can include its context in prompts sent to an external connected agent.
claims.quote: If a connected agent is external to your organization, the primary agent can include information from its context in the prompt it sends to the connected agent.

claims.claim: The primary agent determines what information the connected agent needs.
claims.quote: The primary agent determines what information is needed for the connected agent to respond accurately.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance: Before rollout

claims.quote: Review the connected agent and your organization's data policies before making it available to users.

claims.claim: An agent can connect to up to 10 other agents.
claims.quote: An agent can connect to up to 10 other agents.

claims.quote: You can also add connected agents to Researcher and Sales.

claims.claim: The installation path goes from Deploy agent to selected users through Review permissions directly to Review & finish.
claims.quote: In the Permissions requested window, select Accept to grant the permissions to the agent, and then select Next.
claims.fix: Replace controls[0].ui.path and its rendered table path with 'Agents > All agents > Registry > Status > Available > agent > Install > Deploy agent to selected users > Next > Review permissions > Grant admin consent > Permissions requested > Accept > Next > Review & finish > Finish deployment'. The cited page documents the intervening consent window; do not jump directly from Review permissions to Review & finish.

claims.claim: Connected agents can be reviewed at Microsoft 365 admin center > Agents > All agents > agent > Connected Agents.
claims.quote: In the Microsoft 365 admin center, go to Agents > All agents. Select Researcher or Sales, and then select the Connected Agents tab. On an agent's Connected Agents tab, you can view agents that provide information and answers when users interact with the primary agent.
